name: Ultra Vitamin D 1000IU
description: Vitabiotics vitamin D3 food supplement. Each tablet supplies 25 micrograms (1,000 IU) vitamin D3, equivalent to 500% of the UK nutrient reference value. Original 96-tablet pack.
ingredients: Maltodextrin; bulking agent: microcrystalline cellulose; vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol, antioxidant DL-alpha tocopherol); tablet coating (hydroxypropylmethylcellulose, isomalt, medium-chain triglycerides, calcium carbonate colouring); anti-caking agents: silicon dioxide, stearic acid and magnesium stearate.
directions: Adults: one tablet daily with the main meal. Swallow with water or a cold drink. Do not chew. Do not exceed the recommended daily intake.
warnings: Food supplement; not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet or healthy lifestyle. Not suitable for children. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if pregnant, breastfeeding, under medical supervision, experiencing epilepsy, or concerned about allergies. Produced at a site that may handle nuts. Store in a dry place below 25°C, out of sight and reach of children.
